description: A quantizer that snaps a pitch to one of the equal divisions of the octave, and can thin those divisions further by keeping only every nth step

params.text: Sets how many equal steps the octave is divided into, over 1 to 24, snapping to whole numbers
Keeps only every nth step of that division, over 1 to 13; with the octave in 11 steps and this at 4, the pitches left are the root, four steps up and eight steps up
Nothing in the module reads this control: the value is converted to a whole number before it is used, and every setting in its -0.5 to 0.5 travel converts to 0

inputs.text: The pitch to be quantized, read as 1V per octave

outputs.text: The quantized pitch, as 1V per octave; it is always at or below the input, because each step is reached by rounding downward

notes: The maker's readme says this control adds a voltage offset before the input is quantized, which the built module does not do.

inputs.0:
1V per octave · continuous · one channel only

unpatched it reads 0V.

outputs.0: 1V per octave · stepped · one channel only
